answer: Identity is living wood: each seat leases one mother tree in a registered grove and holds a bearing branch cut from it, grafted onto a numbered trellis frame. A pollen counter there reacts only to local bloom, so each epoch a seat reports the branch's ring width plus the counter's tally; a harbor tide gauge stamps both, so no answer is pre-generated. A branch cannot be copied, and a graft takes weeks. A sybil operator must buy a real tree per fake identity, rent a frame slot, and pay a grafter monthly. Cost scales with the cluster; every tree traces to one nursery invoice.
